doc.brief: The QDockWidget class provides a widget that can be docked inside a [QMainWindow](xref:qt:QMainWindow) or floated as a top-level window on the desktop.
doc.index_brief: Widget that can be docked inside a QMainWindow or floated as a top-level window on the desktop

QAction * toggleViewAction() const.brief: Returns a checkable action that can be added to menus and toolbars so that the user can show or close this dock widget.

QDockWidget(QWidget *parent, Qt::WindowF.brief: Constructs a QDockWidget with parent *parent* and window flags *flags*.

QDockWidget(const QString &title, QWidge.brief: Constructs a QDockWidget with parent *parent* and window flags *flags*.

QDockWidget::DockWidgetFeatures features.brief: This property holds whether the dock widget is movable, closable, and floatable

QWidget * titleBarWidget() const.brief: Returns the custom title bar widget set on the [QDockWidget](xref:qt:QDockWidget), or `nullptr` if no custom title bar has been set.

QWidget * widget() const.brief: Returns the widget for the dock widget.

Qt::DockWidgetArea dockLocation() const.brief: This property holds the current dock location, or Qt::NoDockLocation if this dock widget is floating or has no mainwindow parent.

Qt::DockWidgetAreas allowedAreas() const.brief: areas where the dock widget may be placed

bool isAreaAllowed(Qt::DockWidgetArea ar.brief: Returns `true` if this dock widget can be placed in the given *area*; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isFloating() const.brief: This property holds whether the dock widget is floating

void allowedAreasChanged(Qt::DockWidgetA.brief: This signal is emitted when the [allowedAreas](xref:qt:QDockWidget) property changes.

void dockLocationChanged(Qt::DockWidgetA.brief: This signal is emitted when the dock widget is moved to another dock *area*, or is moved to a different location in its current dock area.

void featuresChanged(QDockWidget::DockWi.brief: This signal is emitted when the [features](xref:qt:QDockWidget) property changes.

void initStyleOption(QStyleOptionDockWid.brief: Initialize *option* with the values from this [QDockWidget](xref:qt:QDockWidget).

void setAllowedAreas(Qt::DockWidgetAreas.brief: areas where the dock widget may be placed

void setFeatures(QDockWidget::DockWidget.brief: This property holds whether the dock widget is movable, closable, and floatable

void setFloating(bool floating).brief: This property holds whether the dock widget is floating

void setTitleBarWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Sets an arbitrary *widget* as the dock widget's title bar.

void setWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Sets the widget for the dock widget to *widget*.

void topLevelChanged(bool topLevel).brief: This signal is emitted when the [floating](xref:qt:QDockWidget) property changes.

void visibilityChanged(bool visible).brief: This signal is emitted when the dock widget becomes *visible* (or invisible).
